page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top left and page number at top right. One main text column with running text, and a narrow note column to its right with one marginal note beside the inscription. No text below the main text.

main_text.p: politani Concilij nomine Imperatori ex-hibitus Libellus supplex. Vos quoque, cum quem decet affectum erga Synodum Sanctam quam convenire iussistis, declarate, quò pias ipsa gratiarū actiones pro Imperij vestri incolumitate persoluat, & nos quoq; pro Regni vestri stabilitate, deuotas ad Christū Dominum preces transmittamus, pijssimi Christianissimiq; Imperatores. Neque silentio praetereunda ipsius Synodi ad ipsum Theodosium Epistola, qua nō obstante Imperatoris severitate, se assidu-as ad Deum pro ejus incolumitate preces effundere profitetur. Inscriptio ita se habet:

[{f}Religiosissimis Christianissimisq; regibus Theod. & Valent. victoribus triumphatoribus semper Augustis, sacra Synodus, quæ per Dei gratiam vestræ Maiestatis sanctionem in Ephesiorum Metropoli cogacta est. S. 7.Ibidem.
Sequitur in corpore Epistolæ, [omnes & singuli assiduas Christo Domino pro Regni vestri stabilitate preces offe-

page.notes: Long s in the scan has been written as plain s. The large initial S of "Sequitur" is joined to the word. The "[" before "omnes" is printed. The word "cogacta" in the inscription is partly struck through or overprinted by the text beside it and is doubtful; "Metropoli" is also overprinted there. The italic/roman division of the inscription is approximate. The marginal note "f Ibidem." stands in the right margin beside the inscription, and its mark "f" is placed before "Religiosissimis" in the text. The left strip of the scan is the edge of the facing page and is not transcribed.
